blocks.html: Piping installed outdoors shall be elevated not less than 3 1/2 inches (88.9 mm) above ground and where installed across roof surfaces, shall be elevated not less than 3 1/2 inches (88.9 mm) above the roof surface, identified in accordance with Section 401.5, and shall not be concealed. Piping installed above ground, outdoors, and installed across the surface of roofs shall be securely supported to the structure and located where it will be protected from physical damage. Where passing through an outside wall, the piping shall be protected against corrosion in accordance with Section 404.11. Where piping is encased in a protective pipe sleeve, the annular space between the piping and the sleeve shall be sealed. At least one end shall have a vented outlet piped to a safe location outdoors. The vent terminal shall be outdoors, minimum 18 inches (457.2 mm) above grade, not under an opening to building or overhang, and shall be installed so as to prevent the entrance of water and insects.
